interface.longDescription: Search thousands of cleared tracks plus partner catalogs. Discover music using your own words or structured filters such as genre, BPM, key and instrumentation. Each search shows up to five tracks, the total match count, and a link to browse, listen to and license every match on onchainmusic.com. Get full details on any track, plus loudness targets, royalty calculations and genre conventions for any music.
